source.citation: C. Cayron, Groupoid of orientational variants, Acta Crystallographica A 62 (2006) 21-40.

blind_protocol: Construct the Burgers OR from the two published parallelisms only. Variant/operator counts are withheld until after subgroup/coset construction.

input.construction: Exact parent/product orientation is constructed only from the two Burgers parallelisms; published variant/operator counts are not used in construction.
